mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS clientId, u.name AS clientName, u.email AS email, u.phone AS phone, co.company_name AS companyName FROM users u LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON u.user_id = cp.client_id LEFT JOIN companies co ON cp.company_id = co.company_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
